entities.summary: The Barsian mosque and minaret comprise a Shi'ite Friday mosque, also known as the Jameh Mosque of Bersian, and 34-metre-high (112 ft) minaret, located in the village of Barsian, approximately 42 kilometres (26 mi) east of Esfahan, in the province of Isfahan, Iran.
